path.style: fill: none; stroke: #000000; stroke-width: 0.8; stroke-linejoin: miter; stroke-linecap: square

text.style: font-size: 17px; font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #172033

g.text: Controlled parameter changes: area versus localization

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #172033

g.text: Baseline: 30 mics · 8 bins · N=512 · 34-bit storage · 3° grid · one window. One setting/group changes per row.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; fill: #475569

g.text: Solid area bars: measured totals. Hatched bars: estimates; * averaging/overlap hardware is unimplemented.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; fill: #475569

g.text: Matching: distinct local maxima within 2.2° of truth and above −12 dB. A coarse grid is judged at the same tolerance.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; fill: #475569

g.text: Zero change in matches does not imply unchanged sensitivity: use the power-retention plot too. These are selected synthetic tests.

path.style: fill: #475569; stroke: #475569; stroke-width: 1.0; stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-linejoin: miter
